title: TRAK — master checklist

release.native: Build 464 · iOS TestFlight internal beta · installed; partial UAT failed
release.backend: Build 463 companion and Search Recents correction live · 1 September
release.next: A local follow-up corrects Build 464's first-update Search shelves, Food Editor first-frame and live nutrition basis, safe-logout presentation and delayed Delete Undo. It is tested source only and needs a new native build; recurring, saved-library and persistence acceptance remain open.

notes: Public, read-only project status. No login needed.
Historical checks are retained separately; a new regression is not closed by an older sign-off.
Updates appear here after the shared checklist is published. Local edits and chat messages do not update it.

changes.text: Build 464 is installed on iPhone and partially failed phone acceptance: the first Search open after updating still waited for Suggested and Recents; Food Editor changed shape after opening and did not update the Nutrition basis from the TRAK number pad; safe logout used a centred dialog; and Delete Undo waited for sync. Stay signed in passed. Local follow-up corrections are tested but are not in Build 464.

Typed Search was separately reported slow again on Build 464. No exact query or Fast-versus-Full timing has been captured, so this remains an open diagnosis and is not claimed fixed by the empty-Search shelf correction.

Build 464 was built and signed locally for iOS and Android from one tested source. It includes the Search and recurring cold-open corrections, exact serving-choice retention for pending or offline logs, and refined iPhone inactive-state diagnostics. It was subsequently uploaded to TestFlight and installed on iPhone; its partial phone results are recorded above.

The Build 463 missing-Recents issue is corrected in the live backend. Suggested habits no longer block recent non-habit foods from the current meal, and the shelves cannot duplicate a card. No new phone build is needed; close and reopen Search to verify.

New Search issue confirmed after installing Build 463: Suggested can appear while the Recents shelf is absent. Recents are currently narrowed to the clock slot, and their meal-period fallback is blocked whenever Suggested has a card.

Build 463 is valid in TRAK's internal TestFlight group and is now installed on iPhone. Its backend and database companion are live. The matching Android build is signed and Aadam is uploading it to Firebase. Recurring-transition and food-editor acceptance remain open.

Recurring transitions and the serving/unit/icon editor are implemented, combined and reviewed locally. Final tests pass: 3,717 native, 108 legacy-login and 630 backend tests. The three final review defects are repaired; one minor empty-panel metadata follow-up remains. Backend/schema release, a new phone build and device checks are still required. Not in Build 462.

Build 462 is available in TestFlight for internal testers; Apple processing and beta availability are verified. The matching Android file is ready for Firebase. Installation and phone acceptance remain open.

Main coordination checkpoint saved for a pause. Build 462 files and release notes are preserved. Resume with delivery and phone checks, address any remaining regression, then serving-size editing. Other work owners are unchanged.

Build 462 signed iPhone and Android files are ready and release tests pass. Includes Search opening, saved-library visibility, recurring refresh and safe logout. Upload, installation and phone acceptance remain; these issues are not marked resolved.
Search opening: a local native correction removes a disk-cache wait that can hold ready Suggested/Recents cards. A new phone build and timing check remain; the wider idle freeze is not closed.
Reconciled the latest handoff: copy work is paused; reference-food publication and source-inventory review remain open.
Published the shared, no-login master checklist with current issues, unreleased fixes and earlier sign-offs separated.
Deployed the upcoming-slot recurring correction; phone acceptance remains.
Search History and recurring additions confirmed working on phone.
Library filtering, recurring return refresh and safe logout corrected in the unreleased native candidate.
